annotator: developer, non-blind (the DEV houses are known from earlier stages; the section-heights reader's DEV probe output had been seen for these sections, its end rows had not been compared with these)
doc: A small set of links between a printed number or an element and what it measures, read from the original images (zoomed 2x crops with a pixel grid in original coordinates) before the v3.46 outputs were scored against them. N, tolerances and categories fixed here. Coordinates: px of the 1138 px section edition.

SECTION_DIMENSION_ENDS.what: a vertical dimension on a section: the rows of its two ends — the face it runs to (slab underside, slab top) or, where the line runs on past it, the tick that ends it
SECTION_DIMENSION_ENDS.note: items marked uncertain carry their own tolerance; the scorer uses max(3, uncertaintyPx)

RELATION.what: a relation between source evidence and the canonical model, checked in the model

items.claim: the attached wing beside the main gable (the body whose plan box starts at the main body's east end) carries a pitched roof, its ridge along X, level with the main ridge (front elevation: a slope seen side on from eaves to a level ridge on the main apex's row)
items.check: a pitched attached roof (not FLAT) over the attached body east of the main body, ridge along X

items.claim: a single-storey house (the page: 'parterówka'; all 13 published rooms on the ground storey); the section prints the attic floor (the ceiling slab's top) at +3,34 and the ground storey's clear height 283
